title: Craft Night Schedule — Badger Supports
description: Relax and unwind at free craft nights for UW–Madison students. No sign-ups or experience needed.

blocks.title: Craft Nights
blocks.lead: Relax & unwind at our free craft nights — no sign-ups or experience needed.

blocks.title: Need a break from classes?
body: Drop in to a Badger Supports Craft Night! Every other week we host fun, creative events where you can relax, meet new people, and make something cool—like bracelets, vision boards, bedazzled crafts, shrinky dinks, & more!

items.text: Drop in alone or with friends — all are welcome!
No experience needed — just show up, hang out, and unwind with fellow Badgers.
All events are free to UW–Madison students, made possible through the General Student Services Fund grant.

body: Badger Supports is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible event. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact accessibility@badgersupports.org. All requests must be made 5 days before an event. We will attempt to implement late requests but cannot guarantee they will be met.
